name: Sheraton Grand Tbilisi Metechi Palace
positioning: City hotel in Tbilisi with panoramic views of the city and the Old Town, minutes from the Abanotubani sulphur baths, with the P'auza Spa and an indoor pool
best_for: City travelers who want views of the Old Town and Narikala fortress and easy access to Abanotubani
Couples and wellness-minded guests who want a spa with an indoor pool, grotto and ice pool

facts.text: The hotel is just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which connects Old Tbilisi with the new district.
Old Tbilisi, Narikala Fortress, Rike Park and Sameba Trinity Cathedral are nearby.
P'auza Spa uses Germaine de Capuccini products in its face and body treatments.
The spa offers couples massages, facials, in-suite massages and manicures and pedicures.
The spa's name refers to the Georgian saying that life is just a minute, inviting guests to pause from the rush of life.
The fitness center is complimentary for hotel guests and includes functional training rigs, squat racks and a boxing room.
Spa guests can stay after the Couple Luxury Suite experience to use the pools, saunas and fitness room for the rest of the day.
The hotel has an indoor pool.

highlights.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.
The hotel's views of Tbilisi overlook Narikala fortress and the Mtkvari River, with mountains around the city.
The hotel is just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi known for its sulphur baths.
The P'auza Spa facilities include an indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room and sauna, plus a spacious relaxation area.
The spa's Couple Luxury Suite experience pairs a couple's massage with time in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.

considerations.text: Metechi Bridge, at the foot of Narikala fort, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
